question: Which organization awarded the Global Technical Recognition to the Sustainable Aquaculture in Mangrove Ecosystems (SAIME) model?

options.text: United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO)
International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)

solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Sustainable Aquaculture in Mangrove Ecosystems (SAIME) model received Global Technical Recognition from the UN’s Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The SAIME model promotes ecosystem-based, climate-adaptive aquaculture with mangrove coverage integrated into shrimp ponds.**
 
• **It has been implemented on 29.84 hectares across 42 farms in the Sundarbans, doubling net profits by reducing production costs.**
 
• **SAIME helps enhance coastal resilience, supports sustainable livelihoods, and promotes chemical-free shrimp farming.**
 
• **It contributes to carbon sequestration and climate action, addressing concerns about the environmental impact of conventional shrimp farming.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Mangrove Ecosystems__

 __
 
• One of the largest mangrove forests globally, located in the Sundarbans
 
• Located on the delta of the Ganges, Brahmaputra, and Meghna rivers in the Bay of Bengal
 
 
 
• Sundarbans World Heritage Site__
 __
 
• Inscribed in 1987 as a UNESCO World Heritage site
 
• Adjacent to the SAIME model implementation area, highlighting the importance of ecosystem protection
 
 
 
• SAIME’s Contributions__
 
 
• Promotes sustainable livelihoods and protects against coastal erosion
 
• Supports the fight against global sea-level rise by integrating climate-adaptive practices in aquaculture
